description: This file defines the EntityFormDisplayInterface, a PHP interface for Drupal that specifies methods for building, extracting, validating, and error flagging form displays for entities.

classes.name: EntityFormDisplayInterface
classes.description: A PHP interface in Drupal defining methods for managing entity form displays, including form building, value extraction, validation, and error flagging.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form for an entity, adding field widgets to the form structure.

methods.name: extractFormValues
methods.description: Extracts submitted field values from the form into the entity, handling reordering and filtering.

methods.name: validateFormValues
methods.description: Validates submitted widget values and flags form errors.

methods.name: flagWidgetsErrorsFromViolations
methods.description: Flags validation violations as form errors for the entity form display.
